I produce promo content for campus groups through my work with Associated Students, Inc. (ASI) at Cal Poly Pomona. Recent projects include a promo/info video for **Campus Rec's Try-a-Tri** beginner triathlon event and a promotional video for **Bronco Fusion**.

**What I do:** concept, structure, editing, on-screen text and styling, and revisions based on stakeholder feedback.
